items.title: Huellitas
items.subtitle: Responsible Adoption Platform
items.description: Digital platform to connect animal shelters with responsible adopters, facilitating the adoption process through user research and design centered on real needs.
items.overview: Huellitas is a platform designed to facilitate responsible pet adoption, connecting shelters and rescues with people interested in adopting. The project focused on understanding the needs of both shelters and potential adopters.
items.problem: Animal shelters face difficulties in giving visibility to animals for adoption and managing the process efficiently. Potential adopters have trouble finding clear and reliable information about available animals.
items.research: Interviews were conducted with shelter volunteers and people who have adopted pets. The main pain points in the current adoption process and the information needs of both user groups were identified.
items.uxProcess: Based on the research, user personas were defined, journey maps were created for both user types, and information architecture was designed prioritizing clarity and accessibility.
findings: Adopters need detailed information about each animal's temperament and special needs
Shelters require tools to filter and pre-qualify adopters
Post-adoption follow-up process is crucial but rarely implemented
Trust and transparency are determining factors in the decision to adopt
items.solution: A platform was designed that prioritizes relevant information about each animal, includes a matching system based on the adopter's lifestyle, and facilitates direct communication between shelters and adopters.
items.results: The case study is currently being documented. Research findings and design process will be updated soon.

items.title: Medical Appointment System
items.subtitle: Medical appointment management
items.description: System for efficient management of medical appointments, designed from research with patients and administrative staff to optimize the booking and appointment tracking experience.
items.overview: Digital system designed to optimize medical appointment management, improving the experience for both patients and healthcare center administrative staff.
items.problem: Traditional medical appointment systems present significant friction: long phone waits, lack of clear confirmation, difficulty rescheduling appointments and absence of effective reminders.
items.research: Benchmarking of existing systems and interviews with patients and administrative staff were conducted to identify the main problems and improvement opportunities in the appointment management process.
items.uxProcess: User personas representing different patient profiles were defined, current flows were mapped identifying friction points, and a new information architecture centered on efficiency was designed.
findings: Patients value autonomy to manage their own appointments
Clear visualization of availability is key for decision making
Administrative staff need consolidated views to manage multiple schedules
items.solution: A system was designed that allows patients to autonomously manage their appointments, with clear confirmations, automated reminders and the ability to easily reschedule.
items.results: The case study is currently being documented. Research findings and design process will be updated soon.
